Modified "Original" receip
Apr 2025 • Family
Used to be a real fan of this "concept"; which is very similar to Peri Peri in Malaysia....

Sadly, felt like the portion been decreasing lately and prices pulled up.

Simple example, the "Original" Chickita burger was litterally two Chicken breasts in a burger bun....and the simple Original was one breast. They removed the Simple version to leave the "Original" that now got only two pieces of tender in it....

The "Original" is no longer....the Original.

I would personally prefer to pay a little more, but keep the same platting than before. My son had to order two main courses to feel satisfied.

Less "Value" meal than it used to be.

Fresh Chicken

Saturday was super-sexy as this chicken dish 😋 

This place had natural and fresh chicken, especially exclusive sauces that were inspired by Asian flavors. The owner made source recipes and it becomes the highlight of the restaurant. You couldn’t find these alike savors in other places. There were 8 types of sauce, each brought a memorable taste, I bet you wouldn’t be able to forget once tasted.
 
The lady who served my table in a friendly great and professional manner. 

On the table, there was leaflets shared story about the farm where feeds chicken and the history of the Chickita brand. A cozy concept of the restaurant with the yellow lights and the attractive view was a plus point for me. I came to the one at Nguyen Van Huong Street, Thao Dien. It was easy to locate and find. As I know, there are many outlets for you to come and try. It’s cool and I will recommend my friends 👍

Chickita Going from Strength to Strength
Mar 2020
Having had a somewhat mediocre meal previously at Chickita and having given an average review, I thought it only fair to update my review as my experience there was totally different yesterday when I went back as a friend's insistence to try it again. This time all of the food was piping hot and instead of the previous rubbery skin this time it was super crispy and the actual chicken was melt in your mouth. Remembering that the French fries seasoning was way too salty last time I asked for french fries without Chickita's seasoning and this time the french fries were perfect - piping hot, tasty and flavorsome. The sweet corn had a welcome buttery taste, and the coleslaw was pleasant. My husband said his chicken and sides were delicious and our friend said that her chicken and sides were 'stunning.' I still didn't find a chili sauce there that had the 'wow' factor although we all thought the black pepper and garlic chili sauce was rather nice. But overall our meals were superb. We'll definitely be there again soon.

Not Quite up to Expectations
Feb 2020 • Couples
I was eager to try this restaurant as it had so many rave reviews. It is bright and cheerful with friendly, welcoming staff. The menu described the chicken as having crispy skin which I love but when it came it was the usual soft rubbery texture. That said the chicken underneath the skin was succulent, plentiful and delicious. However when the meal arrived the french fries and sweet corn were hardly even warm so I asked for the food to be reheated. Eventually it came out piping hot and the taste of all the food was transformed, although the seasoning on the french fries had way too much salt on them so we had to leave most of them. The coleslaw was pleasant enough as was the side salad but the sweetcorn was probably one of the most delicious veggies I have ever had anywhere with a delicious buttery flavour. This restaurant specialise in many different chili sauces and I tried 4 of them but nothing special to my mind. Would I go back? Yes, because even though the skin wasn't crispy on the chicken the chicken was still delicious, the sweetcorn was the best ever and I would have the french fries again but I would tell them to ditch their overly salty seasoning. This restaurant has a lot of potential but needs to ensure that the food is as described and that it is served hot, not an indifferent cool temperature.
